model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different Llama model configurations: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k),” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage,” is linear and spans from 0 to 1.0, with major gridlines at 0.2 intervals. The Llama-3B line (solid blue with circle markers) starts at approximately 0.43 at k=1 and rises steadily to about 0.90 at k=256. The Llama-3B + FT line (dashed green with triangle markers) begins slightly lower at ~0.40 and increases to ~0.89. The Llama-1B line (solid light blue with diamond markers) starts at ~0.35 and climbs to ~0.84. The Llama-1B + FT line (dashed gray with square markers) begins at ~0.30 and reaches ~0.83. All lines show a monotonically increasing trend, with steeper growth at lower k values and leveling off as k increases.
